paragraphs.hr: U K-Drive servisu ne popravljamo samo kvarove, mi pronalazimo rješenja. Fokusirani smo na pouzdanost, preciznost i kontinuirano usavršavanje kako bi vaše vozilo bilo sigurno na cesti.
paragraphs.en: At K-Drive we don't just fix breakdowns, we find solutions. We focus on reliability, precision and continuous improvement so your vehicle stays safe on the road.

paragraphs.hr: Bilo da vam treba redovni servis, hitna popravka ili priprema za tehnički pregled, javite nam se i dogovorit ćemo termin koji vam odgovara.
paragraphs.en: Whether you need routine servicing, an urgent repair or preparation for a vehicle inspection, get in touch and we'll arrange a time that suits you.
